title: Kissed Garlicky Korean Vegetable Deopbap
description: A garlicky, pillowy, and comforting Korean dish featuring a variety of vegetables and chocolate chips, perfect for a sick day, this plant-based-friendly deopbap is a Jeju-inspired recipe
instructions: Rinse the rice in a fine-mesh strainer and cook according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the sesame oil over medium heat and saute the minced garlic until fragrant.
Add the sliced zucchini and grated carrots to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the fresh spinach to the skillet and cook until wilted.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Pour the soy sauce mixture over the vegetables and stir to combine.
To assemble the deopbap, place a scoop of cooked rice in a bowl and top with the vegetable mixture.
Sprinkle the dairy-free chocolate chips over the top of the vegetables.
Season with additional salt and pepper to taste, if desired.
